note: The reconciled country roster of Aoaz at the start of play (1 Lumae 4A 1748), from the fifteen regional dossiers of docs/lore/regions/ and the owner decisions of 24 October 2026. Everything not marked established in the vault is proposed (P). Report: docs/design/roster.md. people is the people that rules and names the realm; peoples gives the shares of the living by headcount (the dead are not counted). faith.pantheon is "twelve" (the twelve New Gods of tools/content/data/world/pantheon.json), "own" or "none"; calendar keys are listed under calendars.

calendars.twelve: The Reckoning of the Twelve: twelve months named for the twelve New Gods, years of the Fourth Age.
calendars.well_count: The Count of the Wells: the desert and coast peoples of Noric speech count years from the digging of the Seven Wells and months by the rains; they use the twelve only in treaties with the west.
calendars.ledger_count: The Ledger Count: the caravan princes count years from the opening of the Gold Road and seasons by the caravans; the twelve months appear only in contracts with the west.
calendars.flood_count: The Count of the Floods: the river-kings begin the year with the Rising of the river and number the years of each king; the twelve are not used in the temples.
calendars.elven_seasons: The elven count of seasons among themselves; the Reckoning of the Twelve with men.
calendars.delving_count: The Delving Count: each hold counts years from its first delving and keeps time by forge-shifts, not by moons; the twelve months only at the gate.
calendars.season_count: By the seasons only, without months: trolls, giants, yeti, ents, the Baelim and the cairn-keepers.
calendars.numbered_musters: The Musters: Volgan's Dominion numbers its months in the Rite-Tongue ("the Third Muster") and will not say the gods' names.
calendars.nether_count: The Count of the Halls: the demon houses count the years of their pacts and of the King's reign.
calendars.knot_cords: The Cords: births and deaths are knotted on cords and years are counted by the knots of the eldest cord; the temple months are refused.
calendars.storm_years: The Storm Years: the islanders of the south name years after their great storms and count months by the tides.
